name: anki-vocab
description: Turn vocabulary from anything — a video, article, image, or a word typed in chat — into flashcards in your own Anki, in any language pair. Follows your existing decks and note types instead of inventing structure. Requires Anki desktop with the AnkiConnect add-on. Skill text is in English. Слова из любого источника — в твою колоду Anki, для любой языковой пары.
